<document id="close-statements">
StatementsˆafterˆclosingˆAfterˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccount,ˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆinˆandˆdownloadˆstatementsˆforˆ90ˆdays.ˆ##ˆDownloadˆthemˆbeforeˆyouˆgoˆWeˆrecommendˆdownloadingˆanyˆstatementsˆandˆtaxˆformsˆyouˆmightˆneedˆbeforeˆyouˆclose.ˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments.ˆ##ˆAfterˆthatˆOnceˆtheˆdownloadˆperiodˆends,ˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen,ˆorˆemailˆus,ˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆtheˆstatementsˆyouˆneed.ˆWeˆkeepˆrecordsˆforˆsevenˆyears.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆinˆtheˆyearˆyouˆclosed,ˆweˆstillˆsendˆyourˆ1099-INTˆbyˆJanuaryˆ31.ˆ##ˆVerificationˆlettersˆAccountˆverificationˆlettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆ##ˆCardˆandˆtransactionˆhistoryˆYourˆstatementsˆlistˆeveryˆtransaction,ˆfee,ˆinterestˆpaymentˆandˆdisputeˆcreditˆforˆtheˆmonth,ˆsoˆthey'reˆusuallyˆallˆyouˆneedˆforˆrecords,ˆtaxesˆorˆaˆloanˆapplicationˆelsewhere.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-business">
BusinessˆaccountsˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆonlyˆoffersˆpersonalˆaccounts.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆbusinessˆaccountsˆforˆcompanies,ˆpartnerships,ˆnonprofitsˆorˆsoleˆproprietors.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆforˆbusinessˆPersonalˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpersonalˆuse.ˆSmallˆamountsˆofˆfreelanceˆorˆsideˆincomeˆareˆfine,ˆsuchˆasˆgettingˆpaidˆforˆoccasionalˆgigs.ˆRunningˆaˆbusiness'sˆregularˆpaymentsˆthroughˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆisn'tˆallowed,ˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆpaymentsˆintoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆpaymentsˆfromˆaˆbusiness,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployerˆorˆaˆclient,ˆintoˆyourˆpersonalˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆdebitˆcardsˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆpersonalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆcan'tˆcarryˆaˆbusinessˆname.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆWeˆonlyˆissueˆinterestˆtaxˆforms.ˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆformsˆforˆbusinessˆincome.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆaˆbusinessˆaccount?ˆYou'llˆneedˆaˆbankˆthatˆoffersˆbusinessˆaccounts.ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆaˆspecificˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="savings-tax-forms">
TaxˆformsˆforˆinterestˆIfˆyouˆearnˆatˆleastˆ$10.00ˆinˆinterestˆduringˆaˆcalendarˆyear,ˆweˆsendˆyouˆaˆFormˆ1099-INT.ˆ##ˆWhenˆit'sˆavailableˆByˆJanuaryˆ31ˆofˆtheˆfollowingˆyear.ˆYou'llˆfindˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆTaxˆforms.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆwhenˆit'sˆready.ˆ##ˆEarnedˆless?ˆIfˆyouˆearnedˆlessˆthanˆtheˆthreshold,ˆweˆdon'tˆsendˆaˆform,ˆbutˆtheˆinterestˆisˆstillˆshownˆonˆyourˆmonthlyˆstatements.ˆYouˆmayˆstillˆneedˆtoˆreportˆit.ˆ##ˆPremiumˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆandˆbonusesˆATMˆsurchargeˆrefundsˆaren'tˆinterestˆandˆdon'tˆappearˆonˆtheˆform.ˆReferralˆbonusesˆmayˆbeˆreportedˆseparately.ˆ##ˆTaxˆquestionsˆWeˆcan'tˆgiveˆtaxˆadvice.ˆForˆquestionsˆaboutˆhowˆtoˆreportˆinterest,ˆtalkˆtoˆaˆtaxˆprofessional.ˆ##ˆWrongˆdetailsˆonˆtheˆformˆIfˆyourˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆonˆtheˆformˆisˆwrong,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆChangesˆtoˆyourˆlegalˆnameˆorˆtaxpayerˆIDˆgoˆtoˆourˆVerificationˆteam.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
